title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running an outdoor eating area on a footpath or other public place.

laws.title: City of Canning Local Government Property and Public Places Local Law 2021

sources.title: City of Canning Local Government Property and Public Places Local Law 2021
sources.locator: cl 4.2(1)(h), as made, Gazette No. 169, 4 Oct 2021
sources.quote: A person must not, without a permit—

sources.title: City of Canning Local Government Property and Public Places Local Law 2021
sources.locator: cl 4.2(1)(h), as made, Gazette No. 169, 4 Oct 2021
sources.quote: establish or operate an alfresco dining area, otherwise than in accordance with clause 7.1.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 129, 26 Aug 2022, Gazette No. 16, 13 Feb 2026); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Using the footpath for outdoor dining needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.

marks.reason: A permit, fees and conditions to trade on the footpath.
